name: Allison Hooker
current_role: Under Secretary of State for Political Affairs (since June 2025)
summary: Allison Hooker is the State Department’s third-ranking official, managing regional and bilateral policy day to day. Confirmed 59–36 in June 2025, she is a longtime Korea specialist who was senior director for Korea on Trump’s National Security Council in his first term.
